answer: Physical capacity accounting is a blunt but workable gate. Each identity declares its hardware and earns credit only for work that fits inside: throughput past ninety percent of declared capacity for three epochs triggers an audit, and receipts from jobs no real machine could produce are voided. A farm running five hundred aliases on one server cannot hide the arithmetic; its walnut shell of specs cracks, and excess income burns. Auditors sample logs monthly, hashing findings onto a shale layer nobody rewrites. Scaling a sybil army steps past the ledge of real silicon.
